description:
-= Bedchamber =-
Ah, the bedchamber. This is some kind of bedchamber, really great ordinary vibes in this place, a wonderful ordinary atmosphere. And now, well, you're in it. You begin looking for stuff.

You see a closed locker here.

You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

There is a key on the floor.
objective: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, retrieve the key from the floor of the bedchamber. If you can get your hands on the key, doublecheck that the locker within the bedchamber is locked with the key. Got that? Good!
